verdict.rationale: HubSpot exposes a broad, well-documented REST API (CRM objects, contacts, custom objects, account info, webhooks) with OpenAPI specs and date-based versioning, and even an MCP server for programmatic CRM access, showing strong parity with UI CRUD operations. However, several UI-surfaced features (AI report-builder in plain language, Breeze AI agents, sequences, workflows builder, deduplication UI) are not shown to have equivalent API endpoints, and the probes show llms.txt/docs.md/openapi.json root discovery endpoints 404, undercutting claims of full agent-readable API parity. missing for 10: API coverage evidence for AI/Breeze agent features, workflows/sequences programmatic equivalents, and working root-level machine-readable discovery endpoints (llms.txt/openapi.json returned 404 in probes).
